hypothesis: A fixed Strength farming composition with committed, risk-priced whole-group clearing and capture will increase matched development wins over edit base ba646c6e. Unchanged or lower win rate falsifies the prediction.
bottleneck: Random stats and incidental nearest-monster attacks do not price whole-group work or reliably complete a productive clear/capture/upgrade cycle.
policy: Vendetta/Varg/Marcella/Tavi/Vesper; finish one Jungle Strength emblem then Power Strength; bounded whole-group throughput scoring with current reward/cooldown observations; commit after damage until reward/recovery/blockage; hold capture; bank promptly; shop and heal on recovery.
expected_change: Higher matched win rate and submitted gems; collected gems and monster deaths diagnose throughput and sustain. No isolated component gain claimed.
falsifier: Matched win rate no higher than the exact edit base. New faults or persistent fuel suspension are validity regressions.
risk: Static full-health work overprices partially damaged groups; risk is a heuristic, not damage prediction. No shared live reservations or split opening roles; duplicates remain possible. Route scoring ignores temporary occupants, and large groups use bounded geometry samples. Capture campers may defer banking; PvP remains basic and no travel dash/crystal policy is added.
alternatives: Deferred PvP disengagement threshold changes (latest evaluated variant regressed against its development base); deferred another narrow banking/target-focus tweak because this older foundation base lacks the integrated economy loop. Boss-inspired value/work routing is adapted with soft risk pricing and personal observations, not copied wholesale.
